Definition: from G4012 and G3007; to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive:--remain.
BiblicalUsage: Perileipo means to be left, to survive, to remain. Paul says we who are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent those who are asleep, and then we who are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that remaining is not the same as being left behind: those alive at His coming are caught up with the dead in Christ, and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
